chapter: Career overview and the Lunceford quarrel
title: Fourteen years with Lunceford, then the Army at Camp Kilmer
summary: Crawford says he drummed with Lunceford for 14 years until drafted, then played in an Army Service Force band at Camp Kilmer.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Now, I drummed with Lunsford's band for 14 years, and the reason I got out of the band, Uncle Sam called me. So I was behind my drum right over there at Camp Kilmer. I was behind my drums. I was with the Army Service Force Charlie Shavers's band, had a big band, playing troops off, playing them back off the ships and boats when they hit New York, down there at the piers
many a night, many a night.
